d: A single mother enters a home improvement competition to save her bungalow before Christmas, but complications arise after she falls for her musician neighbor.

Leaving behind her glamorous life in Hollywood, Evie Lee returns to her small hometown and her family's once-prosperous Christmas tree farm to attend her father's funeral. She must now take over management of the farm, much to the dismay of her younger brother.
A newlywed couples warring kids from past families look set to cause irreparable problems, until their loved-up pet pooches get involved.

When business woman Jennifer is informed her parents are will be away for the holidays without her, she decides to leave her busy city life in San Francisco to visit her Grandma's Inn in Alaska that was left for her in order to fix-up and sell.
